title: Quasi-projective dimension for complexes via filtrations
summary: We extend quasi-projective dimension and quasi-projective length from finitely generated modules to homologically finite complexes by using finite filtrations in the derived category. Our definitions recover the original invariants of Gheibi--Jorgensen--Takahashi for modules and behave well under exact functors, which simplifies the proofs of several results. We establish the Auslander--Buchsbaum formula, the derived depth and width formulas, and the dependency formula for complexes of finite quasi-projective dimension.
